title: Design System: Bitrate for Artists — Dark

body.purpose: Poppins interface copy inherited from the dark Pencil system.

label.purpose: Action text inherited from shared dark component masters.

narrative.overview: A high-contrast production workspace with near-black neutral layers, disciplined purple actions, explicit semantic state, and workflow-specific music imagery. The .pen file remains the source of truth.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black structural surfaces with restrained purple emphasis.
Workflow-specific studio, waveform, patchbay, and spectrum imagery.
Status includes text and does not rely on color alone.
Mobile preserves the desktop decision order.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Working content must remain readable before glow, texture, or image detail is added.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Static designs define intent; keyboard, focus, contrast, motion, and responsive behavior require runtime verification.

dos: Reuse dark variables, masters, and original brand assets.
Integrate each music insert with the workflow it explains.
Keep one dominant action per decision context.
donts: Do not cover working content with bright imagery.
Do not repeat one visual across unrelated screens.
Do not present concepts or demo data as shipped behavior.
